### Abram Moved His Tent
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/abram-moved-his-tent
Passage: Genesis 13:14-18
Points:
- After Abram generously lets Lot choose first, God honors Abram's trust by reaffirming the covenant promises.
- God directs Abram to look in every direction and promises him innumerable descendants and the land forever.
- Walking through the land serves as an act of faith to lay claim to God's sure word before seeing its fulfillment.
- Abram responds to God's reassurance by pitching his tent at Hebron and building an altar of worship.
- Believers can hold earthly wealth loosely and give freely, knowing God's eternal promises far outweigh temporary gains.

### Bible Pathways 01/05/2002
Author: Bible Pathways
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathways-01-or-05-or-2002-1127366.html
Passage: Genesis 13:14
Points:
- Abram voluntarily surrendered first choice of the pastureland to avoid strife and preserve peace.
- While Lot looked with eyes of greed toward Sodom, Abram kept his eyes focused on the faithful Lord.
- Following the separation, God instructed Abram to lift his eyes and survey the full scope of His promised inheritance.
- Any temporary material sacrifice made for God's sake is surpassed by His enduring spiritual rewards.
